item_hexrunicarts_eikthyrheart_desc: The heart of the Horned One, still pulsing with the power of the storm.
hexrunicarts_quest_not_started:
Return to where your journey in Valheim begins.
Find the forgotten runestone near the sacrificial stones.
hexrunicarts_splinter_equip_axe: Equip an axe to use Splinter
hexrunicarts_splinter_weak_axe: Your axe is too weak to splinter some nearby logs
hexrunicarts_lore_splintering_introducti:
In the days before iron, when mortals first walked beneath the gaze of the gods, Thor's thunder shook the roots of Yggdrasil.

From that divine fury, the ancient runemasters learned to awaken the forces hidden within nature.

The first of these forgotten arts was Splintering. Through the axe, they channeled the thunder of Thor, commanding the very fibers of timber to fracture and yield.

Yet the gods do not grant their gifts freely.

Seek Eikthyr, the Horned One, whose antlers command the lightning of the storm. Slay the beast and retrieve his heart, for within it lingers a spark of divine thunder.

Bring forth the heart of the Horned One as your offering.
hexrunicarts_lore_splintering_unlocked:
The gods have accepted your offering.

The thunder once wielded by the Horned One now answers to your axe. The ancient knowledge of Splintering awakens within you.

To cast Splintering, fell a tree and with an axe equipped aim near the log and press {0} to splinter the log.
hexrunicarts_lore_splintering_already_un:
You have already mastered the ancient art of Splintering. The thunder of Thor now answers your call.

To cast Splintering, fell a tree and with an axe equipped aim near the log and press {0} to splinter the log.
